title: RAF Wellington Aircrew
memorial_details: description: IN MEMORY OF THOSE WHO DIED AT STAPLE FARM WITHINGTON / ON 19th APRIL 1943 / IN A VICKERS WELLINGTON AIRCRAFT OF THE ROYAL AIR FORCE / [7 Names] / THEY SHALL GROW NOT OLD, AS WE THAT ARE LEFT GROW OLD: / AGE SHALL NOT WEARY THEM, NOR THE YEARS CONDEMN. / AT THE GOING DOWN OF THE SUN AND IN THE MORNING, / WE WILL REMEMBER THEM.
